t: A 10 to 15 minute whole-room activity that makes text one word at a time.
steps: Find the LLMs Unplugged site and open the modules page.
Open the Search Sheets module page.
Print one search sheet per person.
Gather pens, paper, and dice. Use a d10 for the grid activities.
Prepare a whiteboard or slide to show the words.
Run the activity until about fifteen words appear.
